question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
-- Final answer: count actors with max_gap <= 4
WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.PID,
        TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) as movie_year
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mc.PID, TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER)
),
actor_years_with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        PID,
        movie_year,
        LAG(movie_year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY movie_year) as prev_year
    FROM actor_years
),
actor_max_gap AS (
    SELECT PID,
        MAX(CASE WHEN prev_year IS NOT NULL THEN movie_year - prev_year ELSE 0 END) as max_gap
    FROM actor_years_with_lag
    GROUP BY PID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as actor_count
FROM actor_max_gap
WHERE max_gap <= 4
